items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources, potentially leading to customer account hijacking.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass (B2B)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolving critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution and Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical bug in Magento & Adobe Commerce that allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks have hit over 50% of all stores globally.

items.title: File Read and Remote Code Execution
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical bug in Adobe Commerce and Magento platforms that allows bad actors to read any files, such as passwords and other secrets, and can be combined with another bug (CVE-2024-2961) for remote code execution.

items.title: Magento Security Release (Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.4) Adobe Commerce security release enables attackers to take control of customer accounts.
